title: Let's #TalkConcurrency Panel Discussion with Sir Tony Hoare, Joe Armstrong, and Carl Hewitt
summary: A panel with Tony Hoare, Joe Armstrong and Carl Hewitt, hosted by Francesco Cesarini, on the history and future of concurrency. The three creators of CSP, Erlang and the actor model discuss their differing approaches.
why: HN recommends it for getting the inventors of major concurrency models together, disagreements included.

quote.text: It was interesting hearing them discuss their different thoughts and approaches
